runtime_invariant: glass-box dict lookup ONLY; NO LLM/network/autograd at inference (build-time LLM only)
crlb_n/a: binary attachment-accuracy; no quantitative noise floor for the discriminator
deterministic_seeding: fixed int seeds + numpy default_rng + sorted(set); no hash()-seeded RNG
one_variable_note: All arms share the SAME test items, split, and binary attach mechanism. ONLY the decision source differs: SYNTACTIC=prep-preference (Collins&Brooks, train-fit), RICH=LLM-built triple plausibility (Hindle&Rooth lexical association, build-time), MAJORITY/RANDOM/SCRAMBLED=controls.
leakage_guard: Gold = INDEPENDENT UD dependency annotation (NOT LLM ratings). Rich table generated from a shuffled UNLABELED (head,prep,n2) triple list; agent never sees which head is the gold attachment. LLM rates GENERAL plausibility, so it MUST err on general-vs-corpus divergences (logged as leakage_fingerprint_divergent_items) -> acc_rich < 1.0.
mapped_ceiling_ref: PP-attachment = parser's biggest error class (CITED 18.5% of dep-parser errors). Prior lever exp_pivot_selectional_knowledge_richness_2afc_v1 HARD_PASS (thin 0.475 -> rich 0.814); this cell tests generalization to a 2nd ceiling.
